messages:
Alex: Heads-up — console preflight flagged a 'silent header override conflict' as a warning, but we still managed to save the route and push. Deploy later failed in CI with an ambiguous override error. Is the intent for preflight to block saves or just warn?
Priya: Do you mean two routed rules match the same host/path and set the same header key to different values?
Alex: Yup. Example snippet below that reproduces it — console shows yellow banner but lets the user commit. CI then errors: 'override resolution ambiguous: header X-Env has conflicting values'.
Alex: ```yaml
- route: /api/*
  match: host: example.com
  headers:
    X-Env: staging
- route: /api/experimental/*
  match: host: example.com
  headers:
    X-Env: canary
```
Jamie: Repro steps please? quick paste of which console action you did (save vs save+deploy)
Alex: Save -> auto-commit -> tried canary rollout via console -> deploy blocked by CI. The preflight shows warning only.
Marco: We intentionally made the lint permissive on save to avoid blocking exploratory edits. But surprised it then causes deploy-time failures. Tradeoff between fast authoring vs safe deploy.
Priya: Two orthogonal fixes: 1) escalate that specific lint to error during preflight-run-on-deploy, or 2) improve UX: inline 'effective header preview' that shows final resolved header per route so user knows.
Laura: Preview is nice. Also add a tooltip explaining precedence (route-specific > group > default) and an inline quick-action to 'pick winner' when conflicts exist.
devx-bot: Created issue: GH #482 — "console: preflight header conflict UX and deploy-time mismatch" assigned to @priya
ops-bot: CI: deploy-579 failed at 1763332275 — blocked: ambiguous header overrides (X-Env).
Jamie: My vote: keep soft warning on raw save, but when user runs preflight (or checks the 'validate before deploy' box) make this an error. Add a one-click fix in the authoring pane that sets an explicit override or disables the lower-priority rule.
Alex: I'll mock up a quick UX flow: preflight checkbox toggles strict linting; preview panel shows 'effective_headers' computed from authoring YAML. If accepted, we can push API change to return computed map. Assigning to @Priya for API side.
Priya: :thumbsup: Will review API contract impact. Need to be careful with backward compatibility — maybe a query param `?preview_effective=true`.
Laura: Also add unit/integration tests for rule merging + header precedence so CI doesn't regress.
Alex: Agree. I'll also write a short ADR proposing the 'preflight strict mode' behavior so we have a decision record.
Jamie: Sounds good. For immediate hotfix, we could make deploy pipeline run the same preflight linter to fail fast (so console/save mismatch doesn't surprise infra teams).
Alex: Good call. I'll coordinate with infra to add the preflight-run to the deploy pipeline as an interim. Thanks everyone.
